The proposed amendment to the Matrimonial Causes Act, 2004, also seeks to recognise threats or infliction of grievous bodily harm, as well as emotional and psychological trauma, as grounds for seeking the dissolution of a marriage. The bill, sponsored by the member representing Aguata Federal Constituency of Anambra State, Dominic Okafor, seeks to expand the circumstances under which a spouse can obtain matrimonial relief under Section 16 of the principal Act. Titled: “A Bill for an Act to Amend the Matrimonial Causes Act (MCA), Cap M7, Laws of the Federation of Nigeria, 2004, and for Matters Related Thereto,” the proposed legislation was read for the first time on the floor of the House on Tuesday.
